description: Buy coins after a >10% drop over 4h measured on closed hourly bars (liquidation-cascade overshoot). Scale-in (r30): tranche 1 = 7.5% at the signal close, tranche 2 = 7.5% if an hourly close within the next 12h is a further 5% below the signal close; each tranche held 24h (re-trigger extends), max gross 100%. Hourly only: r28 showed 5-minute scanning catches falling knives (MaxDD −60% vs −28%).
name: crash_rebound
